P.name: Harrier
P.description: {{sbc|Innate:}} '''Quinn's''' ''{{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}}'' against the primary target, ''{{ai|Vault|Quinn}}'', and ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}'' mark enemies hit with ''Harrier'' for 4 seconds, during which they are {{tip|standard sight|revealed}}. '''{{ci|Valor}}''' will periodically mark a nearby {{tip|sight|visible}} enemy if no ''Harrier'' targets exist for 1 second.
P.description2: '''Quinn's''' {{tip|basic attacks}} {{tip|on-hit}} against ''Harrier'' targets are empowered to consume the mark to deal {{pp|15 + (120-15)/17*(x-1) for 20|color=physical damage}} {{as|(+ 40% '''bonus''' AD)}} {{as|'''bonus''' physical damage}}.
P.description4: While ''{{ai|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' is active, ''Harrier'' is disabled and all ''Harrier'' marks are removed.
P.static: {{tt|{{pp|type=critical strike chance|color=critical chance|7*(0.99^((x-1)*10))|key1=%|0 to 100 by 10|formula=7*(0.99^critical strike chance %)}}|Starts after the mark expired or was consumed or overwritten by another mark.}}

Q.name: Blinding Assault
Q.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' sends '''{{ci|Valor}}''' in the target direction who stops upon hitting an enemy, marking them with ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}'' and dealing {{as|physical damage}} to all nearby enemies, increased to 200% against {{tip|monsters}}.
Q.description2: The primary target is {{tip|nearsight|nearsighted}} for {{fd|1.75}} seconds if they are a {{tip|champion}}, reducing their {{tip|sight}} radius to 350 units. Otherwise, they are {{tip|disarm|disarmed}} for the same duration.

W.name: Heightened Senses
W.description: {{sbc|Passive:}} Whenever '''Quinn''' uses a basic attack {{tip|on-attack}} against a target marked by ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}'' or consumes their mark, she gains {{sti|{{as|'''bonus''' attack speed}}}} and {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} for 2 seconds.
W.leveling:
{{st|Bonus Attack Speed|{{ap|28 to 80}}%}}
{{st|Bonus Movement Speed|{{ap|20 to 40}}%}}
W.description2: {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Valor}} grants {{tip|sight}} of the surrounding area for 2 seconds and {{tip|standard sight|reveals}} enemy champions within for the same duration.

E.name: Vault
E.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' {{tip|dashes}} to the target enemy, marking them with ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}'', dealing {{as|physical damage}}, {{tip|airborne|knocking them back}} a very short distance over {{fd|0.5}} seconds, and {{tip|slow|slowing}} them by 50% decaying over {{fd|1.5}} seconds. She then {{tip|dash|leaps back}} 525 units away from them.
E.description2: ''Vault {{tip|basic attack reset|resets}} '''Quinn's''' basic attack timer {{tt|shortly after|See notes}} the initial dash. {{ai|Heightened Senses|Quinn}} can be cast during either of the dashes.''

R.name: Behind Enemy Lines
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' {{tip|channels}} for 2 seconds, signaling '''{{ci|Valor}}''' to pair up. Upon completion, he picks her up and they unite, increasing her {{sti|ms|{{as|{{tt|'''total''' movement speed|Increases base movement as well as bonus movement speed}}}}}}, granting her {{tip|ghosted|ghosting}}, and allowing her to cast ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}''. ''Behind Enemy Lines'' can be recast after {{fd|0.5}} seconds during the channel.
R.description2: Taking damage from non-{{tip|minions}} while ''Behind Enemy Lines'' is active or while '''Quinn''' is {{tip|channel|channeling}} the ability causes her to lose the {{as|'''bonus total''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds. Becoming {{tip|immobilize|immobilized}}, {{tip|ground|grounded}}, or {{tip|silence|silenced}} ends ''Behind Enemy Lines'' immediately and puts it on {{sti|cooldown}} without performing ''{{ai|Skystrike|Quinn}}''.
R.description3: Once ''Behind Enemy Lines'' has been learned, [[death|respawning]] or entering {{tt|any|see notes}} [[Spawn|summoning platform]] will spawn '''{{ci|Valor}}''' instantly.
R.description4: {{sbc|Recast:}} '''Quinn''' cancels the channel, placing ''Behind Enemy Lines'' on cooldown.

R.name: Skystrike
R.description: {{sbc|Active:}} '''Quinn''' detaches from '''Valor''', ending ''{{ais|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' effects and raining arrows down around her, dealing {{as|physical damage}} to nearby enemies and marking them with ''{{ai|Harrier|Quinn}}''.
R.description2: Declaring a {{tip|basic attack}} or casting ''{{ai|Blinding Assault|Quinn}}'' or ''{{ai|Vault|Quinn}}'' during ''{{ai|Behind Enemy Lines|Quinn}}'' automatically activates ''Skystrike''.
